dueno.pruebaTexto: You have full access to all professional features during your trial: complete white-label branding (colors, fonts, and no Rumbia watermark on PDF), team collaboration with up to 3 agents, and official PDF quotes with commercial margins.
dueno.marcaTexto: This branding is seen by every agent in your agency on their PDFs. Only you can edit it.
dueno.logoAyuda: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 2 MB.
dueno.colorAyuda: Used in the badge, day markers, and activities on the PDF. With your plan, the footer also stops mentioning Rumbia — the document goes out with your brand, period.
dueno.personalizacionTitulo: Full customization available on Agencia and Agencia Pro
dueno.personalizacionTexto: Choose your own accent color for the PDF and remove the Rumbia mention from the footer —
dueno.codigoInvitacionTexto: Share it with your agents; they enter it in their profile to join this agency.

dueno.zonaPeligroConMiembros: While there are other agents in your agency you can't leave: they need to leave first, or you can remove them from the list above.
dueno.zonaPeligroSinMiembros: Leaving deletes the agency, since it would no longer have an owner.
